what: End-to-end verification of the exact Hugging Face Space artifact (deploy/hf_space/, assembled by scripts/deploy_hf_space.py --dry-run), built and run locally because HF returns 402 Payment Required on new Docker Space creation for free accounts (PRO now required; the create failed before any secret provisioning, so no key left the machine).

image.built_from: staging tree assembled by deploy_hf_space.assemble() — 145 files, secret scan clean

boot.command: docker run -d -p 7860:7860 crewml-space:day30 (no GROQ_API_KEY — the state a fresh Space has before its secret is set)

crew_run.note: MOCK MODE — zero LLM calls; these numbers exercise the pipeline inside the Space image and are NOT live-LLM results (EVAL_PROTOCOL labelling rule).

cache.backend: file (no CREWML_REDIS_URL — the fail-open path is the Space's path)

conclusion: The artifact the deploy script ships boots both processes on the Space contract (one container, app_port 7860, UID-1000 user), verifies the baked sealed splits, and completes a full seven-node crew run with the holdout untouched. The only step not exercised is HF's own build+host, gated on a PRO subscription: python scripts/deploy_hf_space.py --set-secret --wait 900 once the account is upgraded.
